purpose: External service and environment contract for moving from local legal-RAG smoke tests to production-grade retrieval, reranking, durable ingestion, review promotion and private-source controls.
principle: Local-hash vectors are allowed for dev smoke tests only. Production-scale retrieval requires a real embedding provider, a real reranker, durable orchestration, reviewed gold cards and tenant/private-source controls before private books/forms influence answers.

stages.label: Local dev smoke
stages.target: Run public bail/inconsistent-pleadings pilots with local Qdrant and local-hash vectors.
notes: Good for smoke tests and quote-verified rule batches.
Not sufficient for semantic retrieval quality or 20k scale.

stages.label: Bail next rung, 20-50 cases
stages.target: Scale the bail-only public source batch while keeping outputs candidate-only.
notes: DeepSeek may propose extraction rules, but exact quote and doctrine-node validators decide what enters the batch.

stages.label: Production retrieval
stages.target: Use real vectors and reranking for meaningful legal retrieval.
notes: Changing embedding provider or dimension requires recreating/reindexing Qdrant collections.
OpenAI is optional; Voyage/Cohere are supported.

stages.label: Durable ingestion
stages.target: Run retriable background ingestion jobs with observability.
notes: Use INNGEST_DEV only for local development.
Use event/signing keys for hosted ingestion jobs.

stages.label: Gold review gate
stages.target: Promote a small reviewed bail authority set before larger scale.
notes: Promotion must use the review API/CLI after human legal review.
No script should bulk promote machine_candidate cards.

stages.label: Private source ingestion
stages.target: Allow licensed books/forms only in tenant-isolated private namespaces.
notes: Do not enable private source ingestion merely because storage exists.
Private sources require tenant filters, access logs, review status and no raw text exposure.

stages.label: 10k public-demo scale
stages.target: Run up to 10000 public cases once production embeddings, reranker, orchestration and vector namespace isolation are green.
notes: Lawyer gold review is optional at 10k; machine_candidate source-linked demo remains allowed.
Never index local-hash vectors into _prod collections.

stages.label: 20k preflight
stages.target: Plan large-scale ingestion but keep execution blocked until all gates pass.
notes: This remains preflight-only until the scale readiness report is green.
Scale section-by-section; do not bulk auto-attach across the whole criminal tree.
